subject: crop insurance PMFBY premium farmer share
text: Crop insurance PMFBY: what a farmer pays as premium in Andhra Pradesh, from Rabi 2024-25 onwards, extended to 2026-27 on the same terms. Enrolment is voluntary. The farmer's share is limited further if the actuarial premium rate is lower.
